Inference pipeline

Proposed system flow from uploaded image to interpretable output.

01Preprocess

Resize, normalize and validate the image.

02Segment

Predict the weak lesion boundary and mask.

03Fuse

Combine image features with the lesion region.

04Classify

Return class scores and visual evidence.

Model specifications shown here are illustrative frontend profiles until training artifacts are connected.

Responsible use

This project is designed as an explainable research aid. It does not replace examination, dermoscopy review, histopathology or a clinician's final decision. Model outputs must remain traceable to the model version and evaluation record used to produce them.

ATransparent

Show masks, boundaries and confidence.

BVerifiable

Record metrics and model versions.

CEfficient

Prioritize compact inference profiles.

DAssistive

Keep clinical judgment with the user.

Analysis complete
